statBlock.name: Kobold Scale Sorcerer
statBlock.description: A kobold sorcerer advises its tribe and uses magic to strengthen the warren. It may speak for a dragon that the tribe serves.

sections.Traits:
Sorcery Points. The kobold has 3 sorcery points and regains all spent points when it finishes a long rest. When it casts a spell that calls for a saving throw, it can spend all 3 points to give one target disadvantage on its first save against that spell (Heightened Spell). It can also spend 1 point when it casts a spell to skip that spell's somatic and verbal components (Subtle Spell).
Pack Tactics. The kobold has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if an ally is within 5 ft. of that creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.
Sunlight Sensitivity. While in sunlight, the kobold has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
sections.Spellcasting:
The kobold is a 3rd-level spellcaster and uses Charisma for its prepared sorcerer spells (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will). Fire Bolt, Mage Hand, Mending, Poison Spray.
1st level (4 slots). Charm Person, Chromatic Orb, Expeditious Retreat.
2nd level (2 slots). Scorching Ray.
sections.Actions: Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

statBlock.name: Korred
statBlock.description: A reclusive fey that knows stone and ore. Korreds meet weekly to dance and beat out rhythms on stone with their clubs and hooves.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Stone Camouflage. The korred has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide in rocky terrain.
Stone's Strength. The korred rolls two extra damage dice with each weapon attack it makes while on the ground. Its attacks below include those dice.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
The korred uses Wisdom for its innate spells (spell save DC 13) and supplies no components.
At will. Commune with Nature, Meld into Stone, Stone Shape.
1/day each. Conjure Elemental (cast at 6th level, summoning only a galeb duhr, gargoyle, earth elemental, or xorn), Otto's Irresistible Dance.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Greatclub attacks or two Rock attacks.
Greatclub. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (1d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage, or 19 (3d8 + 6) if the korred is on the ground.
Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +9 to hit, range 60/120 ft., one target. A hit deals 15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage, or 24 (4d8 + 6) if the korred is on the ground.
sections.Bonus actions:
Command Hair. The korred has at least one 50-ft. rope made from its hair. It can command one such rope within 30 ft. to move up to 20 ft. and entangle a Large or smaller creature it can see. On a failed DC 13 Dexterity save, the rope grapples the target (escape DC 13). The target is restrained for as long as the grapple lasts. The korred can release the target as a bonus action. The target is also freed if the korred dies or becomes incapacitated.
Hair rope. The rope has AC 20 and 20 hit points. It recovers 1 hit point at the start of each of the korred's turns if it has at least 1 hit point and the korred is alive. At 0 hit points, the rope is destroyed.
sections.Magical hair: When cut, hair from the korred's head becomes the material that cut it. Korreds use iron shears to make the strands for their iron ropes.

statBlock.name: Kraken Priest
statBlock.classification: Medium humanoid (any race), any evil alignment
statBlock.description: A kraken grants magical power to a follower. The priest's body changes to reflect its patron, sometimes growing tentacles or mouths that dribble seawater.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits: Amphibious. The priest can breathe air and water.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
The priest uses Wisdom for its innate spells (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks) and supplies no material components.
At will. Command, Create or Destroy Water.
3/day each. Control Water, Darkness, Water Breathing, Water Walk.
1/day each. Call Lightning, Evard's Black Tentacles.
sections.Actions:
Thunderous Touch. Melee spell attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 27 (5d10) thunder damage.
Voice of the Kraken (recharges after a short or long rest). A kraken speaks through the priest in Abyssal, Infernal, or Primordial. Its voice carries 300 ft. A creature the priest chooses that can hear the words must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma save or be frightened for 1 minute. An affected creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
sections.Patron control: While on the same plane, the kraken can faintly sense the priest's thoughts. It can push aside the priest's personality and take control.

statBlock.name: Leucrotta
statBlock.description: This foul-smelling creature has a badgerlike head, a hyena's body, and deerlike legs. It mimics voices to draw prey into an ambush and leaves tracks that can pass for those of a deer.

sections.Traits:
Keen Smell. The leucrotta has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
Mimicry. The leucrotta imitates animal sounds and humanoid voices. A listener can recognize the imitation with a successful DC 14 Wisdom (Insight) check.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Hooves attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage. On a critical hit, roll the damage die three times instead of twice.
Hooves. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Bonus actions:
Kicking Retreat. If the leucrotta attacks with its hooves, it can take the Disengage action as a bonus action.
Rampage. When the leucrotta drops a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on its turn, it can move up to half its speed and make one Hooves attack as a bonus action.

statBlock.name: Martial Arts Adept
statBlock.description: A trained monk who might guard a monastery, travel to learn new techniques, or work as a bodyguard.

sections.Traits: Unarmored Defense. The adept adds its Wisdom modifier to its AC while it wears no armor and wields no shield.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Unarmed Strikes or three Dart attacks.
Unarmed Strike. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, the adept may choose one additional effect. A failed DC 13 Strength save makes the target drop a held item of the adept's choice. A failed DC 13 Dexterity save knocks the target prone. A failed DC 13 Constitution save stuns the target until the end of the adept's next turn.
Dart. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.
sections.Reactions: Deflect Missile. When a ranged weapon attack hits the adept, it reduces the damage by 1d10 + 3. If this reduces the damage to 0, the adept catches the missile if it has a free hand and the missile is small enough to hold in one hand.

statBlock.name: Master Thief
statBlock.description: A thief known for daring heists. A master thief may leave fieldwork behind to run a guild or spend the proceeds in peace.

sections.Languages: Any one language, usually Common, plus Thieves' Cant.
sections.Traits:
Evasion. If a Dexterity save would let the thief take half damage, the thief takes no damage on a success and half damage on a failure.
Sneak Attack (1/turn). When the thief hits with a weapon attack, it adds 14 (4d6) damage if it had advantage on the roll. It can also add the damage if an ally that isn't incapacitated is within 5 ft. of the target and the thief didn't have disadvantage on the roll.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Shortsword attacks.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.
Light Crossbow. Ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Cunning Action. On each of its turns the thief can Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a bonus action.
sections.Reactions: Uncanny Dodge. When an attacker the thief can see hits it with an attack, the thief halves the damage it takes from that attack.

statBlock.name: Maw Demon
statBlock.description: A demon of Yeenoghu that joins gnoll raiding parties and attacks their prey. Gnolls summon one through a ritual offering of freshly slain humanoids.

sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Rampage. When the demon drops a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on its turn, it can move up to half its speed and make one Bite attack as a bonus action.
sections.Devoured offerings mechanics: After the demon rests for 8 hours, anything it devoured goes directly into Yeenoghu's gullet.
